confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: {name} ({address}) accepts writes for {count} of its BTHome objects. Home Assistant will create a control for each, alongside the sensors it already reads from this device.

user.title: Add a writable BTHome device
user.description: These devices are on the air and declare writable objects. Pick the one to set up.

reconfigure.title: Encryption key
reconfigure.description: {name} ({address}) is currently advertising {state}. Enter its 32-character BTHome bindkey to let Home Assistant seal writes to it, or leave the field empty if the device no longer uses encryption. Nothing else about the device changes, and its entities keep their names.

get_encryption_key.title: Encryption key
get_encryption_key.description: The data broadcast by {name} ({address}) is encrypted. In order to decrypt it, and to seal the commands sent back to it, we need a 32 character hexadecimal bindkey — the same one the device was given.

abort.not_supported: This is an ordinary BTHome device: it does not declare any of its objects as writable, so there is nothing for this integration to do. Its sensors are handled by the BTHome integration.
abort.nothing_writable: This device carries a writability declaration, but it lists no object type this integration can offer.
abort.no_devices_found: No writable BTHome device is currently within range. These devices announce themselves, so if yours is powered and nearby it will appear on its own — check that it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_on_the_air: This device is not currently advertising, so a key cannot be checked against it. Accepting one unverified is how a device comes to be configured and then never work — try again once it is in range.

error.bindkey_required: This device advertises encrypted, so it needs a key.
error.decryption_failed: The provided bindkey did not work, sensor data could not be decrypted. Please check it and try again.

write_failed.message: {name} could not be reached: the command was not delivered. {error}
